title: Agent versions: each prompt's history from git, its scripted checks, and its live results placed by date
request: The owner asked for the prompt version of each agent and its improvement over time, like the lead agent against Claude alone.
spec: For every prompt: its versions from git; the results that recorded its hash; the live results of the suites that send it placed in the version in force on their date; whether the version in force now has a live result; on the command line and the Admin Benchmark tab.
plan: read each prompt's versions from git
find that live results record no hash and place them by date
the map of suites to the prompts they send, read from the code
the command, the route and the table

decisions.decision: A scripted suite's hash is a check, not a measurement
decisions.why: the scripted suites record every prompt's hash for the prompt gate but send no prompt to a model

decisions.decision: Live results are placed in a version by date, through an explicit map of suites to prompts
decisions.why: the live suites record no prompt hash; without the map every live result would land under every prompt

decisions.decision: An uncommitted edit is never called measured
decisions.why: a run on uncommitted edits cannot be told apart from the version before them

change: dclab_rnd/bench/versions.py (new), dclab_rnd/bench/__main__.py (versions), agentic/pages/bench.py and accounts/guard.py (the owner-only route), views/admin.html (the table), the generated app, docs/guides/BENCHMARK.md, tests/test_bench_versions.py.

findings.defect: Every prompt read as measured on its current version
findings.scenario: the first timeline showed measured now for all prompts
findings.cause: the scripted agent suite records every prompt's hash although it sends none of them to a model
findings.fix: hashes count as checks; only live results of the suites that send a prompt count as measurements

findings.defect: Live results were credited to prompts they never sent
findings.scenario: exam relabellings and runs with only Claude alone counted as runs of the lead agent's prompt
findings.cause: every result of a suite was given to every prompt mapped to the suite
findings.fix: an exam result counts only for the prompts of the arms that ran there, and a result without arms counts for none

findings.defect: Dates in mixed time zones were compared as text
findings.scenario: the changes since the last pass were counted on text dates with different offsets
findings.cause: the comparison skipped the conversion to universal time
findings.fix: dates are converted before they are compared, and a version's date is its commit date

measurements.name: the timeline on the repository
measurements.gate: read by hand against the commit log
measurements.result: the lead agent's versions show their live runs and spend, and the newest version shows none, as the commit log and the exam results say
limits: placing by date is an approximation: a run on uncommitted edits lands in the version before them
the suite map covers the lead agent, Home and the journeys; other agents show checks only

outcome: Each agent's prompt versions are shown with how each was measured; a version in force that no live run measured is named.
lessons: check what a record really holds before linking by it: the hashes were in the free suites, not in the paid ones
risks: the suite map must be kept current when a suite starts sending another prompt
